get.description:
Get a list of configured Media Adapters. Adapters define storage backends and root paths for media files. For examples of how to use Media Adapters, please refer to

[https://github.com/joomla/joomla-cms/blob/6.0-dev/tests/System/integration/api/com_media/Adapters.cy.js](https://github.com/joomla/joomla-cms/blob/6.0-dev/tests/System/integration/api/com_media/Adapters.cy.js)

Discover adapter IDs through /media/adapters; local-images is site configuration, not a universal ID. /media/files/{path}/ lists a directory; the same path without the trailing slash reads one item. Use JSON rather than multipart. For files, provide base64 content; for folders, omit it. PATCH requires at least path or content; explicitly set override: false to forbid overwriting. Allowed extensions, MIME types, sizes and operations depend on Media Manager and adapter settings.

The media models return the retrieved set without standard page slicing; do not use page[limit] to infer completeness. File lists support filter[search] and search_recursive. The url, temp and content query flags select optional URL, temporary URL or encoded-content attributes where the adapter supports them. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

get.description:
Get the Media Adapter with a specific adapter_id.

Discover adapter IDs through /media/adapters; local-images is site configuration, not a universal ID. /media/files/{path}/ lists a directory; the same path without the trailing slash reads one item. Use JSON rather than multipart. For files, provide base64 content; for folders, omit it. PATCH requires at least path or content; explicitly set override: false to forbid overwriting. Allowed extensions, MIME types, sizes and operations depend on Media Manager and adapter settings.

The media models return the retrieved set without standard page slicing; do not use page[limit] to infer completeness. File lists support filter[search] and search_recursive. The url, temp and content query flags select optional URL, temporary URL or encoded-content attributes where the adapter supports them. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Adapter ID, a colon and the path from the root of the adapter, for example `local-images:/banners/osmbanner1.png`. Get the adapter IDs from `/v1/media/adapters`. A folder lists its items, a file gives a list with only that file. Without `path` the list is empty. Unlike the path parameter of `/v1/media/files/{path}`, this one also works when the slashes are URL-encoded.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Add the public URL of each file as `url`.

parameters.name: temp
parameters.description: Passed on to the media adapter; Joomla core and its local adapter do not use it.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Add the Base64-encoded content of the file as `content`.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Adapter ID, a colon and the path from the root of the adapter, for example `local-images:/banners/osmbanner1.png`. Get the adapter IDs from `/v1/media/adapters`. End the path with `/` to list a folder. Do not URL-encode the slashes: with the default Apache setting `AllowEncodedSlashes Off`, a `%2F` in the URL path gives a 404 from the web server before Joomla is reached.

parameters.name: url

parameters.name: temp
parameters.description: Passed on to the media adapter; Joomla core and its local adapter do not use it.

200.description: The Media File, or the items in the Media Folder.

BearerAuth.description: Joomla API token of a user, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Users get their token on the Joomla API Token tab of their profile. The plugins "API Authentication - Web Services Joomla Token" and "User - Joomla API Token" must be enabled.

JoomlaToken.name: X-Joomla-Token
JoomlaToken.description: The same API token in the `X-Joomla-Token` header. Joomla tries to extract a Bearer token first and reads this header when the extracted token is empty. A non-empty Bearer token takes precedence even when authentication fails.

BasicAuth.description: Username and password of a user. Only works when the plugin "API Authentication - Web Services Basic Auth" is enabled, which it is not by default.

JUpdateToken.name: X-JUpdate-Token
JUpdateToken.description: Update token of the Joomla Automated Updates service, set in the options of Joomla Update. Only used by the `/v1/joomlaupdate` endpoints.
